subject: Kickstart Roadshow — milestone cadence & owners
messages:
From: Maya Lewis <maya.lewis@optohealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickstart Roadshow — initial ask

Team —

Thanks for the call this morning. We want to run a small ‘roadshow’ pilot for OptoHealth: integrate Redwood inference for provider-facing summarization across two clinics, then scale across 12 clinics by Q4. Target go-live for the pilot: Oct 15, 2029.

To move quickly we need a clear mutual action plan (milestones + owners), a procurement checklist (PO timing, contract redlines), and an implementation timeline with gating criteria (QA, security sign-off, performance SLOs). Can you share a one-page MAP and a proposed milestone cadence by EOD Friday?

Procurement note: our procurement lead (Tom Raines) will need SOC-2 evidence, indemnity language, and a draft SOW. CC'd procurement ops above.

Thanks — looking for a concise set of ask/responsible/dates so we can align internal stakeholders.

Best,
Maya Lewis
Head of Clinical Ops
OptoHealth

---
Attachment: procurement_requirements_OptoHealth.pdf (pdf, stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Maya Lewis <maya.lewis@optohealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart Roadshow — initial ask

Hi Maya — thanks, and great to meet the team this morning. Draft attached: one-page MAP + milestone cadence (Kickstart_Roadshow_MAP_v1.xlsx) and an implementation RACI (Implementation_RACI_v2.pdf). High level below —

Milestone highlights (proposal):
- Milestone 1: Pilot scoping & acceptance criteria — owner: OptoHealth Clinical Lead (Maya) / Redwood CS (Evelyn) — target: 2029-08-02
- Milestone 2: Contract & PO executed — owner: OptoHealth Procurement (Tom) / Redwood Sales (Jonas) — target: 2029-08-30
- Milestone 3: Dev integration & staging validation (data contracts, synthetic tests) — owner: Redwood Eng (Marcus) / OptoHealth Eng — target: 2029-09-20
- Milestone 4: Pilot UAT & perf tuning — owner: OptoHealth QA / Redwood CS — target: 2029-10-04
- Milestone 5: Pilot go-live & acceptance — owner: OptoHealth Ops / Redwood CS — target: 2029-10-15

Proposed cadence: weekly 30-min checkpoints (Wed 11am PT) + a triage channel for blockers. Please review the owners and dates in the attached MAP and flag any conflicts.

Open items we need from OptoHealth this week: confirmation of procurement contact (PO cadence), desired acceptance criteria for summarization quality (sample prompts/labels), and access to a sandbox dataset for integration testing.

I’ve added a column in the spreadsheet for the OptoHealth point of contact and acceptance criteria — can you fill that by Friday? We’ll lock the calendar for the first checkpoint once we have confirmation.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite after procurement contact is confirmed.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: Kickstart_Roadshow_MAP_v1.xlsx, Implementation_RACI_v2.pdf

Adding a couple of sequencing details and owner clarifications based on follow-up with legal and marketplace:
- Contract sprint: Redwood Sales (Jonas) will lead the redline loop and aim to produce an “exec-friendly” SOW + commercial summary by 2029-08-16 to speed PO approval.
- Procurement artifacts: we will provide SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, and a draft SLA template—Marcus will attach the technical pack to this thread by EOD Monday.
- Kickoff meeting: propose July 29, 2029 at 10:00am PT for the official cross-functional kickoff (we'll keep it to 45 minutes). I added the calendar link in related_links.

Quote from Maya below for visibility:
> To move quickly we need a clear mutual action plan (milestones + owners), a procurement checklist (PO timing, contract redlines), and an implementation timeline with gating criteria (QA, security sign-off, performance SLOs).

Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Maya Lewis <maya.lewis@optohealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-22T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart Roadshow — milestone cadence & owners

Dropping in the technical checklist and a note on capacity risks. Attached is the technical pack (summary + perf targets). Key callouts:
- We recommend reserving dedicated capacity for the 2-clinic pilot window (Oct 10–Nov 10) to guarantee latency SLOs during validation. Owner: Redwood Eng (Marcus) to propose capacity spec by 2029-08-09.
- Gating: security sign-off (Infosec checklist complete) and synthetic perf tests at 95th percentile must be met before pilot UAT. If capacity is constrained, we’ll have an automatic fallback to batch-mode processing for non-critical traffic (detailed in the pack).

See quoted line below from Evelyn's plan for dates — please confirm if the Oct 4 UAT window works with your ops calendar.

Confirming:
- Acceptance criteria: F1 > 0.78 on our labeled sample for summarization and median latency < 450ms on test harness.
- First checkpoint: July 29, 2029 10:00am PT — confirmed.
- Procurement lead: Tom Raines (tom.raines@optohealth.com).

I’ve uploaded a short PO timeline doc to the folder (see drive link). We’ll fill the acceptance criteria column in your MAP by Friday.

Thanks — excited to get started.
